# AI templates — vision-aligned pack

**Purpose:** Reusable prompts and agent floors that help **DTRT Lab** and **Ian’s career** without hype theater.  
**Filter:** `docs/vision.md`  
**Last built:** 2026-10-13

## What we implemented (adopted)

| Template | Helps | File |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Agent floor (AGENTS.md) | Every coding agent stays on vision | `/AGENTS.md` |
| Cursor always-on rules | Honesty + dual brand in every chat | `.cursor/rules/*.mdc` |
| Free plan delivery | Useful Lab product | `free-plan-delivery.md` |
| Paid scope proposal | Honest paid work (no fake guarantees) | `paid-scope-proposal.md` |
| Career outreach | SA / Manager / Creative job search | `career-outreach.md` |
| Lab social caption | Quality Lab VO/posts (not CS2 clutter) | `social-lab-caption.md` |
| Evidence status update | Dated `/live` honesty | `evidence-status.md` |
| Weekly decision filter | Personal + company weekly check | `weekly-decision-filter.md` |

## What we skipped (and why)

| Common AI template | Why out |
| --- | --- |
| “10x growth / Fortune” founder decks | Fake scale |
| Live ecommerce checkout copy packs | Checkout not live |
| Hiring / “we’re growing the team” kits | No hiring pipeline |
| Aggressive cold-spam sequences | Burns trust; not Made for all |
| Reverse-engineering / clone-app kits | Explicitly out of vision |
| Generic purple SaaS landing generators | Fights Studio Identity |

## How to use

1. Open the template file.  
2. Fill the `{{placeholders}}`.  
3. Paste into Grok / ChatGPT / Claude / Cursor Agent.  
4. Fact-check numbers against `/live` or real notes before sending.  
5. Never invent clients, metrics, or live checkout.
